name: private-subnet-generator
title: Private Subnet Generator
description: Generates IPv4 and IPv6 prefixes according to RFC1918 and RFC4193. Excludes commonly used IPv4 and IPv6 subnets, such as CGNAT, Docker bridge, …
author: cmdr

commands.name: generate-private-ipv4-prefix
commands.title: Generate Private IPv4 Prefix
commands.subtitle: Address Allocation for Private Internets
commands.description: Generate an IPv4 Prefix according to RFC1918

commands.name: generate-private-ipv6-prefix
commands.title: Generate Private IPv6 Prefix
commands.subtitle: Unique Local IPv6 Unicast Addresses
commands.description: Generate an ULA Prefix according to RFC4193

preferences.name: history
preferences.title: History
preferences.label: Keep previously generated prefixes
preferences.description: Show previously generated prefixes below the new one.

preferences.name: historySize
preferences.title: History Size
preferences.description: Number of previously generated prefixes to keep per command.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
